integrity: The entire finite search and orbit calculation are supplied as standalone integer-only Python code. Repetitions in the equation are explicitly included. The self-review is not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite classification only. No theorem for higher ranks or general moduli; no independently validated novelty or external mathematical certification. The motivating source later proofs and a related primary paper were not fully inspected.
title: Four affine classes of maximum solution-free sets over the rank-two eight-adic group
